content:
emily_partnerships: Ok team — quick sync. We're kicking off an SI 'Welcome & Enable' sprint for Q2. Goals: 1) Bootcamp week + office hours 2) Cert badge path 3) HW kit access + marketplace listing checklist. Tentative dates: bootcamp May 10-14. Thoughts?

raj_singh: Love it. Confirming HW kits: do we have inventory for 12 partners? @alex_t?

alex_t: Yes, 12 prepped. Need shipping addresses by Apr 20. I'll send spreadsheet.

maria_g: Training prework: i'll create a 20-min self-paced module on Redwood API best practices. I'll own content. ETA Apr 12.

jordan_k: Can we add a live lab where SIs deploy a model to Dedicated? 60-min hands-on. Also request internal oncall for lab support.

emily_partnerships: Agree. Add canary deploy walkthrough. Office hours: daily 9am PT during bootcamp. @onboard-bot can you create recurring event?

onboard-bot: Event created: SI Bootcamp Office Hours, May 10-14 9:00-10:00 PT. Invite: #si-onboarding + participants list.

raj_singh: Certification gating: need 3 checkpoints — prework quiz, lab completion, live Q&A. Badge issuance via LMS. Who owns verification?

maria_g: I'll coordinate LMS. Badges via Credly? Need legal sign-off for partner logos on collateral.

emily_partnerships: Legal loop: @jordan_k please ping Legal about co-marketing logo usage. Also we want a soft joint announcement after successful bootcamp week — tentatively May 20.

alex_t: :thumbsup: Shipping spreadsheet link: https://example.com/shipping-spreadsheet. Please fill by Apr 20.

jordan_k: Legal notified. They asked for partner list and draft copy by Apr 25.

raj_singh: On logistics: lab VPCs will need pre-provisioned creds. I'll produce a terraform snippet for onboarding:

`````
resource "redwood_lab_vpc" "si_lab" {
  name = "si-bootcamp-vpc"
  region = "us-west-2"
  access_role = "si-lab-role"
}
`````

maria_g: We should add a short eval form after each session. Helps catch regressions and feedback.

jordan_k: We should run a dry-run May 3 with two partners. Volunteer partners?

maria_g: EdgeWave and Clearpath said yes.

emily_partnerships: Great. Action items summarized: Alex -> shipping spreadsheet Apr20; Maria -> prework + LMS Apr12; Raj -> terraform + lab creds Apr28; Jordan -> legal + draft Apr25; Emily -> announcement draft May 18. We'll reconvene Apr 5 10am PT. :calendar:

alex_t: noted.

raj_singh: ack.

maria_g: ack.

jordan_k: ack.
